notes.title: Progress Update - New class backgrounds, new game?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e4e4755fa194e2b1545444cf55a16d51999291ac.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders!

I thought I'd share with you what I've been working on during these last couple months...

[h1]New Class Backgrounds[/h1]

I've been making great progress on more backgrounds (subclasses) for the new classes from the latest big update. These new backgrounds will be added in the next big update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/feb8c6497da6f393ec2d8f7dc836ebfe5abe9d94.gif[/img]

[b]Highlander Duelist[/b]

This is a variant of the duelist which has shield proficiency, and plays like a crossbreed between the Duelist and Knight.

He has a unique passive called "Counter Attack" - when blocking a melee attack, the highlander duelist will deal damage equal to his strength!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/021e7f53c3d281820b8c21678a74eb21439e07d7.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/851ca0e433afb301f52ef9cfb54b7ff41276d7cd.gif[/img]

[b]Metalworking Alchemist[/b]

Another background I've been working on is the metalworking alchemist - which is an alchemist background with mace proficiency, and metal-themed abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/163bafc7db5dea3d4482870c8237aa8708ee3697.gif[/img]

Instead of the Sage Alchemist's power potion, it has a limited "Magnetic Detoxification" heal, which also pulls allies nearby and out of danger.

it shares some abilities with our current sage alchemist but also has a few unique ones, like it's final ability "Magnetic Storm" which weakens, slows, and pushes enemies in a massive range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/453fcf3900a5b055aa913f2178e1ff2204de7213.gif[/img]

[b]Marshland Healer[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2998ee186938f6b34f9b073392aa93b2afc9cd4c.gif[/img]

The last variant I'll showcase today is the Marshland Healer, which has some interesting unique abilities compared to the folk healer...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e8b42d9d2460d00d95f2421dec924b84985c9c71.gif[/img]

Their default healing ability is ranged and can stun enemies! meaning more utility, but it can't cure status and has fewer uses than the Folk healer's default heal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a0fa9ffb7196d1ea7bf1a6323a97860031a2b9d3.gif[/img]

They also have a level 2 skill called "Swampfire potion" - which is a slightly weaker version of "Swampfire Arrow" with more limited range and uses. (Still extremely powerful and dangerous!)


[b]More enemies![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/28b65033836120467257bc8d9a63a60a946bb1ad.gif[/img]

A new enemy joins the Primordial Jungles... this is the Vine Guard! Which will entangle your units from a distance. While a mere annoyance as a single enemy, it can become deadly when joined by other foes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/bf936b6b0b7d3e727a5742fb9ee30a4e5a523436.gif[/img]

[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]

I've been improving the UI too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/deba95405517c78e3dfcf1982fd740ed3f5ce6c5.png[/img]

For example you can witness this new main menu when launching the game.

However, these UI improvements are still not complete - there's definitely a lot more UI to improve in the future!


[h1]New Game?![/h1]

Meet "Heroes Against Time", a roguelite about building the perfect team in an enchanted forest which I'm releasing in two months!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667720/

It started as a gamejam project at the very start of this year - but I thought the concept was extremely fun and I decided to turn it into a full game, so I've been working on it alongside Netherguild. It currently has a demo you can try out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a253a5c2326b8edca7d96373988a1d6795e274ef.png[/img]

[b]What does this mean for Netherguild?[/b]

Nothing, really; I've been working on both games these last few months, keeping up with weekly updates on the Netherguild discord.

I might end up taking a week long break when HAT releases but otherwise I'm still working on Netherguild, all the way until it's finished in a few years from now.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45639430]You can also follow me on Steam now![/url]

[h1]Other stuff...?[/h1]

I got to showcase both of my games at a local game development conference!!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a066ff0eef6c1b1dfbd994e62be3f6fa5b5e430a.jpg[/img]

It was my first time doing something like this and it was awesome watching people play Netherguild and Heroes Against Time. I think people are a lot more familiar with Netherguild's gameplay nowadays after playing Baldur's Gate.

[h1]The end![/h1]

And that's all for now - it's a bit of a long update, but I hope it made for a fun read.
Thank you so much for checking it out, and see you next time!

-David

notes.title: Progress Update - Deep in the jungles...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9bf014af25ef6f33bc6ae75bc6421f5fbda1d6a3.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders!!

I wanted to share some of my progress on the next upcoming area - The Primordial Jungle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/22a2205965881ebda066b8022cdcdec5535a1682.png[/img]

This is going to be an area full of various strange creatures and plant monsters;
I've been working on it for only have a month so far but I got some fun stuff to share!

[h1]Wildlife[/h1]
In the Primordial Jungle area, many creatures who are small on the surface have grown and evolved into their own niche due to the lack of competition -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c132529031cc2c17f521bbd1f72160290c589057.gif[/img]
For example, the majestic Bullfrog will be one of the creatures in this area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9b5abcab3a91ea09d36259fdfc2f6c65553e0d0e.gif[/img]
A MoleWolf - (Wolf Mole? name in progress!) these are moles that have evolved to hunt in packs far underground, they're roughly the size of a dog compared to a person;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/cc359b879d8d2b285c11f0ed37b890739621b468.png[/img]

They may look a bit like a sausage but they will be quite the hassle to deal with when fighting large numbers of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/60a3397d6949e152d3c3b4825093216b5271d9e8.gif[/img]

They will alternate between various attacks making for dangerous combos....


[h1]Bonfires and Items[/h1]
But wait... since the Primordial Jungle is full of trees, would it have logs?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4cdec0dbf41df75d92ff0c94905c311ba3ef40ce.png[/img]
Yes! But... most logs you find would be these damp logs that burn poorly;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f3097929f56991f5e4dfb1222b072f99b889fc96.gif[/img]

Meaning; easily accessible bonfires that damage your characters when resting! Use them carefully...
(There will also be a warning if a character might die from them).



[h1]Terrain[/h1]
After the Sewers and Damp Caves, I wanted to have terrain that is a bit more interesting to navigate and has some height to it again - as you can see in the hill posted below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3bfd5ab81d572e4d1e8fc24bda9a3afb13c5cab1.png[/img]

[h1]The End[/h1]
And that's all for now - thank you for reading.
Hope it made for an interesting update, and I'm looking forward to sharing more in the following months!!

-David

notes.title: Lvl 5 abilities and 2025 Plans!
notes.content:
Hey Guild Leaders!!
Lvl 5. abilities for all backgrounds are finally here as well as some exciting news I have for my 2025 Netherguild plans! So let's get into it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/92dae14297d286637753ce65da6f9d7e03bf95ad.png[/img]

[h1]Brand new Lvl 5. Abilities[/h1]
[b]Each class background[/b] gets their own unique lvl 5. skills (18 new abilities overall!) these will [b]usually [/b]be powerful abilities with few uses per bonfire / expedition. 

I added a bunch of new mechanics so expect some fun powers like having another turn for your character, or all characters gaining "undying" for a turn: a status effect which prevents death. Some abilities also deal massive damage or other handy and more standard status effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0eb49cf23be964e249835fb4542a41c690ab392a.gif[/img]

Situational but powerful "nukes" you can reserve for the right moment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/88ae5e38649575f3c411e456e432cdc25e246a57.gif[/img]

I'm looking forward to hearing your feedback about which abilities you like best :D



[h1]What's Next..?[/h1]

I wanted to share some of my plans for Netherguild with you - keep in mind these are not set in stone, but they're a general guideline for how I wish to expand Netherguild in 2025.

Also, let me know if there's anything else that's missing or something you'd like to see!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d51000d1e6195cdae802ac985ed80ffc0567c5bf.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved UI and other polish[/h1]
I've been learning pixel art in my spare time (example above!) so I might try to spend some time and use my newfound knowledge to try and improve the game's interface - be it healthbars, various screens and more. 
Obviously it's going to be tough but I think it's worth doing or at least trying out!!

I also think features like being able to sell items in the market would make learning Netherguild easier for newbies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9f1465c2ae108a303c4d3f2e55f8cd6cea7eca85.png[/img]

[h1]Afterwards[/h1]
I want to work on the upcoming jungle area - as well as adding more backgrounds for each new class (Duelist, Hero, Alchemist, Healer).
(and perhaps progression beyond lvl 5.)


[h1]The End?[/h1]
And that's all for now!! See you in the next update :D
-David

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE - 4 New classes, 2 New Floors, New Loot and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e06d2dce73c1647c299759a6e93a4fb6576d2262.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders!

Fantastic news, the big update is here! I made a short preview video:

[previewyoutube=jws4-U_1PIA;full][/previewyoutube]

However, if you prefer reading (or want more details) I got you covered too! (:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c918c634c43b0a068f4ba0a9980194e8ba0dc70f.gif[/img]

[h1]New Classes[/h1]
Each one of these classes currently has 1 background each(!) but more will be added.

To access these classes, you need to reach 7 or more renown with any of the two current main factions - the Nobility or the Commoners.

[h2]Nobility Classes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4587c790fd3a9dbeeaa0b726eb5c5b5a66ff0766.gif[/img]
[b]Duelist (Damage, Control)[/b]
The duelist is the master of incapacitating his enemies and controlling the battlefield - increasing bleed counters and dealing bonus damage to incapacitated and otherwise weakened targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e586036909a39c70dfe2e307cfb145b1d5fc24f9.gif[/img]
[b]Alchemist (Buffs, Healing, Status)[/b]
The alchemist class is a powerful ally to have - strengthening allies, and having many dual-use abilities which can buff allies and harm enemies, as well as an especially powerful one-use healing ability which is only bound by your character's max health.

"Sage Alchemist", the current Alchemist background has two innate abilities: 
[list]
[*]Strength Potion - which slows and strengthens the target
[*]Transmutation - A one time use ability which restores 60% of an allies HP.
[/list]

[h2]Commoner Classes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/cd8d2c4690da15ee41108e73753cfc681d4d78a3.gif[/img]
[b]Hero (Tank, Damage, Buffs)[/b]
The Hero is an extremely powerful tank, with plenty of Block abilities and self buffs. The current background "Inspiring Hero" is focused on blocking and building up buffs on allies before dealing massive damage or doubling their buffs. 

It has one powerful innate ability:
[list]
[*]Inner Potential - Gain block, strengthen, and focus.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3a1cd983628dbcfca00a39cbf1b5addea3086f82.gif[/img]
[b]Healer (Healing, Status)[/b]
The Healer class is, unsurprisingly, the master of Healing - as well as harmful status effect on enemies.
The "rural healer" background has one innate healing ability:
[list]
[*]Herbal Bandages - Heals 2 health, cures bleed and slows target. (5 uses).
[/list]-but it's extremely powerful level up skills more than make up for it.



Leveling up healing units is easier as well with them earning a bonus XP each fight - however, they are still [i]very[/i] capable of dealing damage and are not to be underestimated on the battlefield.

[h1]Two New Areas[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/474872d0eee67c49b40a6a0b24f62aef628cfd7c.png[/img]
[h2]Mist City Sewers[/h2]
Full of ancient sewer cleaning automatons, various creepy crawlies and crocodiles (!!!), the forgotten sewers are not an easy area to traverse. Sewage water which slows allied and enemy units makes fights even more challenging, which makes some enemy fights even tougher.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a605719e8c211198cb977020e025c0813f57f2f8.png[/img]
[h2]Damp Caves[/h2]
Full of various fungal folk which debuff your units to oblivion! weakening, disorienting, poisoning and stunning constantly. 


[h1]The End? Nay! More![/h1]

There's a whole lot of other new additions in this update like loot items for existing areas, as well as some existing abilities which got rebalanced (read as: buffed).

I genuinely hope you have a good time exploring all the new additions to the game! and as always, there's a lot more new stuff I have planned for the future (':

That's all for this update!!! If you enjoyed it please leave a kind review, and if you have any feedback I'd love to hear it here on Steam's forums or in the game's Discord.

See you all in future updates to come-

-David

notes.title: Playtesting Open, Big update soon!
notes.content:
Hey Guild Leaders!

These last few months I've been putting the finishing touches on the upcoming big update;

If you want to try it out early, the instructions are at the bottom of the post! but beforehand, I want to show some of the cool things I've been working on since last update;

[h1]Faction Following is COMPLETE[/h1]


This includes the various enemy units of factions following you underground; It doesn't happen in-game because there are no negative events which lower your faction favorability enough, but that will be added in the future >:D 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ad94ca9f65b842c1a80db3b2d5594fbe1291f603.gif[/img]
An example: the squires who buff their knight allies and hang in the back -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b631910f43b1a4fec7e5bcd0341b52b28954a328.gif[/img]
Or the commoner hero who alternates between lecturing their gullible follower peasants and attacking your units.

[h1]Various Oddities[/h1]
Various unique oddities were added to the new areas, currently 3 new oddities for each new zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d82f9d8f899a296ca6c5ab3261ecff75052257f2.gif[/img]
A forgotten research lab in the damp caves, with instructions for how to create powerful items, and ingredients you can gather from the long forgotten inhabitants of the area...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d96b5da6ce775821f3f64ba6023740f98bc3b198.gif[/img]
As well as a large manhole which can serve as a risky but handy shortcut in the sewers...

[h1]New Food Effects[/h1]
I've added a few new food effects that would affect your resource management and rests...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/82571d26fcfca8221f54b9ae346c6b64af6f0565.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d16e279e864b325adc9d69feb2b1adc13a91ee3c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/072026562a0e7f4657c7f949df48873b7b999684.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/76fb76329b54ce9e39f7ed88c8edeb6f96d63297.png[/img]


[h1]Playtesting[/h1]

Want to try out the big update early and find possible bugs?

Here are the steps to do so!

1) Right click on Netherguild in your steam library > Properties > Betas
2) Enter the code "ForgottenRoads" and choose to opt into the beta at the bottom. Make sure it changes in the top right!
3) Try it out and let me know if you have any feedback in the usual channels! be it through the Steam forums or through the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Discord [/url](Do mention that it's beta testing related though pls)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c5a0e36fac1a25e37c963824ce8f60c2b3d62231.gif[/img]

Speaking of which, if you don't want to grind through the entire game again to try out both factions, I have ready-made saves in the #weekly-news channel in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url] that you can download and try out.

Addition summary:
4 new classes (2 for each faction)
Faction stores and unique food items
2 new areas

Hope you enjoy playtesting if you do! I plan to hopefully release this update sometime before the new year.

Thank you for reading and may you always return from your expeditions,
-David

notes.title: Bonfire Improvements + New classes almost complete!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3d312a4b6fdc105515e4d0450b2a8c6b6a032efc.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders!

I got a shorter update for you this time around - mainly an improvement to bonfires and update on the upcoming Hero class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7b401aaee81a610a044688cb451f8e88f6d3ab20.jpg[/img]
[h1]Bonfire Improvements[/h1]
When I started out this update, I wanted to improve the bonfire mechanic - there were multiple issues with it, like how the interface text was too small and how it was somewhat annoying to have to constantly open up your character inventory to switch food items between characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d326c54765cde346bcde1ddcbc3aac60792ffc5c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/daeba4194776b02bffae5c71d604cb234ce947f7.png[/img]

I tried out various changes like different camera angles and a new interface, but they ended up not working out so I had to discard them for now :/

So instead of redesigning everything from scratch, I just improved the current interface significantly -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b0d85ce2df6e06961795f4e6b3f459107cf43f8a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2bc3d8fdf9fcf452ff3e0abf9e472533fe469ad4.png[/img]

I am glad about the more visible and less fiddly interface now though, hopefully it makes the lives of players easier.


[h1]Hero Class Almost Done[/h1]

The new hero class is almost done! the current background "Inspiring Hero" (background name is not final) will be a buff-based tank / damage dealer - it has some unique abilities, like doubling all the status effects on a character - and dealing damage based on the combined status effects of all party members.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1607c497ee7cbd607a160eda97e7855d1f7b6af9.gif[/img]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

[u][b]New Area Progress[/b][/u]
-Three weeks
I want to spend some time finishing up the new areas and playtesting the upcoming classes! I hope to have the almost ready so I can release the upcoming major update sooner.

(I also wanted to improve the visuals of the overworld, but I want to delay that update at the moment so I can focus better on finishing the upcoming big update with the new areas and classes before doing overworld polishing).

[h1]Fin[/h1]

And that's all for now!
Thank you for checking out this update, hope to have more exciting upcoming stuff to show off next time.

-David

notes.title: The Speech Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/352b32daf263e76ad78cd75e52719447cb96b6a5.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders!

Today I have a new update with improvements to the speech system, new character lines as well as other small fixes and improvements.

[h1]Update Overview: What does this update contain?[/h1]

[h3]Updating Speech in Existing Saves[/h3]
In the past, for players to update their character's speech lines, they'd have to start a new save - but no more!

Now when you load an older save, it'll update character speech - which means I can add new speech lines and they'd appear in your saves, just like that. To those who stayed here for a while, you might recall I added something similar with updating skill trees in existing saves before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1a96a151b006b51860c5b8d265f1dd681f0863e7.gif[/img]
[h3]Added tech for new classes to appear in the guild[/h3]
[i](Work in progress gif above)[/i]

It should be extremely easy for me to unlock these classes using the faction system :D Look forward to that in the upcoming big update! (hopefully in a few months from now).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9a31bd1aa19a8a679c7a52a51049184e6bad1312.gif[/img]
[h3]Speech Interruption[/h3]
Before, characters would ramble on before enter combat - and then the new speech bubble would overlap the old one. I didn't like how it looked so I changed it up a bit to look more natural!

Also don't worry, this doesn't make you miss any text - you can still see what characters intended to say in the action log in the bottom left of the screen.

[h3]New Speech Lines[/h3]
Characters can now chat about additional enemies joining combat, about killing enemies, about unlocking new currencies (like the silver crowns) and more. They can also be aware of which weapon they're holding when talking - so a shield holding Mercenary Knight has a small chance to comment on wanting to repair their shield when they rest near a bonfire.

You can also check out the full patch notes here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3882729325726400950


[h1]What's next?[/h1]

[b][u]Working on new areas and classes[/u][/b] 
-A week and a half
I want to focus on making focused progress on the new areas and classes! I might work on other small additions during this time too.

[b][u]Expanding the Bandit Stronghold[/u][/b] 
-Two weeks
I wanted to add a new rare enemy and an oddity to the Bandit Stronghold 

[h1]Fin[/h1]
That's all for this update!!
Thank you for reading and see you with all with an exciting new progress update in a week and a half hopefully :D

-David

Automatons used to struggle with climbing up and down to reach player characters. The idea behind this was that automatons aren't as clever as living creatures, but it could result in some very un-challenging encounters in a middle-game area, which I didn't like - so now their AI has been improved.

[b][u]Achievements 2 weeks[/u][/b]

I want to add more achievements for players to unlock!
For two weeks, I want to add 

[b][u]Controller Support Initial[/u][/b]

I want to check out what I'd need to use to add controller support. I won't be adding it yet, but I want to outline what's necessary to add it.

[b][u]More Speech[/u][/b]

There's two things I want to add during this update;

2. Expanding the speech system, adding more lines, context (for characters) and other improvements.

And that's all for this update - apologies for the wait, this update ended up dragging on too long, something I hope to avoid with future updates!

Thank you for reading and see you next time :D

Or even worse, when you accidentally trigger enemies across multiple rooms in the Bandit Stronghold / City of Mist...

That should be fixed! There are now invisible "barriers" that prevent enemies from activating other enemies in nearby rooms. However, you can still activate those far away enemies by yourself - if you chance upon them...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/860557823392240a3ce8ba5d17350446f277d53f.png[/img]
[h1]Still working on the Royal City Update![/h1]

Since adding new rooms might mess up existing saves, I added a system to prevent that (':

Dungeons will now save the version of the dungeon, so a player loading a save from a certain time will have the proper rooms instead of future rooms - until they descend into the dungeon again (or go down to the next floor).

I've also started working on some alternate room layouts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d7522799da4f788b7987469a67c6c617159d58ab.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you for 50 reviews![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9d946c97a78ce079e63bf6106a82c6054ecd9e05.gif[/img]

And that's all! Just wanted to share this surprise update with you since I'm excited about finally releasing the new visuals and combat fix.

I'll try to update the store screenshots in the next few days too to reflect the new visuals - and sometime afterwards I'll finish making a new trailer.

Thank you for reading! See you next update (:

notes.title: The Mist City METAL Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b2c56c54351fba5d1e65c6e8b251d9f8ad2d9f32.png[/img]

Hey guild leaders!
For the last few weeks I've been working on this new update improving various aspects of the City of Mist area; here's a quick overview of everything that's been added and some of my future plans :D

Full patch notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3660914264330759952

[h1]What's New?[/h1]
Two new rare automaton enemies were added: The Tin Flamer and Tin Champion.

The Flamer shoots oil and blankets your units with flames,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/24faf088cae712be5216f516d20216be5c246c94.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c0d59feeb60aa6eb42b327ebe28ce5900c5d5a92.gif[/img]
The Tin Champion pushes units two tiles away and stuns them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/789230350aca7897873c7a93cfc976a2db647897.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/040f7430d15961d125076874639799677bf98031.png[/img]
Tin Champions will also drop this key - which can be handy for cracking open vaults safely. 
Vaults also have a 10% chance for a nastier encounter including a tin champion and tin general, so these keys might come in handy...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f7678659a184922042db88ace0822788d8cc70ec.png[/img]
As you explore the City of Mist, you might also encounter rare lore columns in certain rooms (especially the shrine oddity room), giving you some optional lore about the history of the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e5af1f1f9671a546f57cd5afea35f68f97f7ddb5.gif[/img]
Another addition is the metal shop in the City of Mist - which lets you trade scrap metal you gain from defeated automatons into reclaimed metal which can be turned into solid but not amazing equipment in the overworld (besides one powerful item) - the idea here is giving the player an option to cover their bases when it comes to any missing equipment, regardless of random loot finding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/36732c5c1266a007059615217cd1f1e8597a1c29.gif[/img]

And as a final addition, your inventory is shown when interacting with the market, letting you know just how many logs are missing :D

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
[b][u]Graveyard Update[/u][/b] 
-A week and a half
Adds a graveyard building in the overworld where you can visit your fallen heroes, as well as minor improvements to the game.

[b][u]Temporary Allies[/u][/b] 
-Two weeks
Will add one or more oddities that give the player a temporary ally to command underground, as well as the technology required for temporary allies.

[b][u]The Royal City[/u][/b] 
-Two to three weeks
Will improve the City of Mist with more details, special rooms and oddities.

All these while secretly working on new areas and classes behind the scenes... [u]before a big update in a few months!!![/u]

Speaking of this... here's some of what I've been working on in the background...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f1e7c190937844e85eef2eeda8cac1b12ecc7de9.png[/img]
[i]Tileset for a future area...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c27f6728731af795beb22d7019515536784f9641.png[/img]
[i]Class background models for the duelist (noble) and hero (commoner) classes[/i]

For the big update in a few months from now, I plan on adding 2 brand new areas - both with their own unique loot, oddities and enemies, as well as at least two new player classes (possibly more).

And that's all for this update, thank you for reading it so far :D
I'm off to rest up after playtesting the new additions all morning long - see you all next time! (:
Cheers!

-David

This last week and a half I've been working on some quality of life improvements, a few slight improvements to the interface as well as handful of new loot items for the Nobles & Commoners factions.

[h1]Enemy initiative doesn't reveal positions[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/42f518b95414bdf7fe2eb4dbee4911871be83c61.gif[/img]

Before, when initiative rolled, hidden enemies would reveal their position with the "initiative rolled" text - but now only visible enemies display it.

This should make mobility and scouts an even more important part of your squads.

This is a big change so let me know if it's fun or if it messes things up in any way!

[h1]Item Snapping[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/61edb9e63534e32694027d965d776fce4516fe0e.gif[/img]

Netherguild has a lot of inventory management... so I figured, why not make it a bit more comfortable?
Items now snap to their slot, making it easier to arrange items rather than having to carefully place them.

[h1]Chests and Vaults Remain Half Open[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2574a3d51abfdd2db0de53d8c53d64186e5921be.gif[/img]
After opening a chest, it will remain half-open; this is to show it has been looted (by you) before.

A community feature originally requested by [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/MrDelightfulRPG/]Mr.Delightful[/url], this should make backtracking easier.

I've also added some tiny visual improvements to the rest of the interface:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/56e7f0e686bfef3f6efc93942263a9cb82cbe9d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3f52c09fc2e3873bd54f5c3f5d76211dfcc7d41d.png[/img]

As well as 2 new boot items and a new bow (for the Commoner set).
I wanted to improve the interface a bit more and maybe add a couple of additional items, but I ended up running out of time for it during this update... so I might do it anyway in the next few days or save it for the future (:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1b4d02a41aea56fc7eb5fe7b1de734a357ee05c2.gif[/img]
[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

[b][u]City of Mist - Metal Update[/u][/b] 
-three weeks
New automaton enemies in the City of Mist area, new loot and more. Stay tuned!

[b][u]Multiple City of Mist Improvements[/u][/b]
-???
Adding more content to the City of Mist across multiple game-updates while secretly working on new areas and classes behind the scenes... [u]before a big update in a few months!!![/u]


[h1]Reverse Roadmap[/h1]

A few weeks ago I was talking to a friend of mine who worked on a couple other games (asked to remain anonymous for now).
I mentioned how I don't like roadmaps - which are good for hype, but make me worried about deadlines and delays...

So he came up with this clever idea of having a "reverse roadmap" - instead of a regular roadmap filled with hopeful promises, this is a list of things that have already been added to the game during early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f51407dc456fedffcf9394c94b0a84e06625ce14.png[/img]

I thought it'd be a good idea to 1) show new players that the game is being continuously updated, and 2) to show returning players everything new since they've last played at a glance. 

This will mainly include exciting content and exclude other things like interface improvements, bugfixes and quality of life additions, which are important but would end up cluttering the list.

In any case, explanation over! expect to see it pop up throughout early access (:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1ff1fe4b7ff89eaaeb94bff0cd0bcab96d74782b.gif[/img]

And that's all for this update - thank you for checking it out (:

See you all in a few weeks with some brand new content for the City of Mist as well as more info on the big update that's dropping in a few months from now!

-David

Hunt III: 5 Noble standing, completed Hunt II, visit the City of Mist (middle).

notes.title: New Skills! And more...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/25ce07114fe6343d1ffd5ef65482d2ea72c4cc16.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders,
I wanted to write a quick update to detail all the newly added content in the newest version of Netherguild as well as future plans. Let's get into it!

[h3]Table of Contents[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Three New Skills[/b] (and item)
[*][b]Balancing[/b]
[*][b]What's next?[/b]
[/list]

[h1]New Skills[/h1]
Now that Netherguild is in early access, I wanted to be able to add abilities and skills over time - HOWEVER! there was an issue...

Since skill trees are saved on a character, adding a skill would mean that it will only exist on newly hired characters... 
But just syncing skill trees is not enough, because: what if a skill gets removed from the game after a player bought it? That would mean a skill point gone forever!

Therefore, this last week and a half I worked on a system for updating skill trees in existing saves - which neatly updates skills and skill trees if there's any new modifications.


[i]Beyond that I also added three new abilities! Here they are in detail:[/i]

[h3]1) Icicle Piercer[/h3]
> North Guard Ranger
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/55d3ab248eb200e13aaec5a698c56d597d2881cf.gif[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/114cb9ee5b65cbd826cb5801ba330b3e87ace04f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c3bf1f26e00fc917c10e5643c68b5a2704161606.png[/img][/url]
[quote]Icicle Piercer (Requires Bow)
Ranged Attack 1-5 area range, Accuracy + 1 Piercing
Cooldown: 3 | Uses: 3/3
Targets all units in line.
Unblockable.
+4 Damage when target has Slow status[/quote]


[h3]2) Rigged Coin-Toss[/h3]
> Contractor Assassin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/80cb464bd59390ca6cf258b99204190d5fc65f74.gif[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/78b095d96490b02b1348d4830283b0623d31a8fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ded2e5616bc173d841cbb7395669bdab9aeeb5f5.png[/img][/url]
[quote]Rigged Coin-Toss
Cooldown: 2 | Uses: 3/3
Targets the user.
Free Action- Doesn't end turn.
If fighting against more than 3 enemies:
Gain 3,1 Focus
If fighting against 3 or less enemies:
Gain 3,1 Strengthen
If health is 8 or less gain Block[/quote]
[i]Note - the "speech" effect for coinflip will only appear with newly hired Contractors rather than already hired ones.[/i]


[h3]3) Flare Arrow[/h3]
> Scout (All backgrounds)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ecfd65ebddb2abc048528195a89cb3476305706f.gif[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c6b7204e29c6b7e252b5ad1f8eda8156c4aa27dc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/343101cf8b2a2014689f928cd54913bf7ff326b1.png[/img][/url]
[quote]Flare Arrow (Requires Bow)
Ranged Attack 2-8 range
Cooldown: 3 | Uses: 2/2
Inflicts 3,2 Burn: Deals 3 Fire damage every turn for 2 turn
Allies gain 1,3 Focus: Increases Accuracy by 1 for 3 turns[/quote]This skill also gives 2 additional uses to "Track" (context in "Balancing Changes").


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/6d8f931a3e749add2f682596cc2ff10a0f2ae9df.gif[/img]
[i]There's also a [b]new trinket[/b] that can be crafted from the rare plates of the armored grub![/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1329c4c51d6a78dbd099b8c9ced7d1155722e9e5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/902bc0b02029824f1c0b1fcf3605c5ba57dc5041.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Balancing Changes:[/h1]
Alongside smaller changes, here are the two major shifts in this update:
[olist]
[*][u]Increased uses for the Scout's [b]"Track" ability[/b] when certain level 3 skills are chosen.[/u]
This should let players have a slightly easier time at lower floors which can require using "Track" to prepare for enemy encounters and navigating the dungeon.
[*][u][b]Sidestep abilities[/b] now let you use your remaining movement BUT will always let you move at least 1 tile.[/u]
Which should let you capitalize on your full range of movement while still serving as a useful escape when your character has no movement otherwise.
[/olist]Full patchnotes:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3683424562639566741

[h1]What's Being Added Next?[/h1]
[b][u]Overworld Interface and More[/u][/b]
-Week to two weeks
Inspecting characters in guilds showing true stats (rather than starter stats), "Are you sure?" window for firing characters / attacking allies, more info in the dungeon-log and other possible improvements.
(Might include one big patch or incremental patches)

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3703688858596410641?l=english
(Mentioned in this update previously)

There might be more to this update than what's written here - and while it isn't [b]"the BIG UI improvement update"[/b] [i]yet[/i], I did recently chat with the talented developer of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005430/The_Call_of_Krular/]"The Call of Krul'ar"[/url] who taught me some great UI design principles that I'm looking forward to sneaking into this update, as well as implementing over time in future updates.


Thank you for reading!
-David

notes.title: Week 1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ca87b92365243f05ae376d83f135eaddbaece398.png[/img]

Hey Guild Leaders,

I wanted to write an update on the status of Netherguild, including the early access launch as well as what I'm planning to work on next - this week and onward! [i]So get ready for an expedition...[/i]

[h3]Table of Contents[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]State of Netherguild[/b] (Sales? Bugfixes?)
[*][b]Fixes & additions planned this week[/b]
[*][b]What's next?[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1fc1b108e18bb999ef4ca5ffe83b062d0b611b3e.png[/img]

[h1]State of Netherguild[/h1]
Before release, I estimated how much Netherguild would sell (based on wishlist numbers) - However, the first week Netherguild sold far below what I was aiming for - more or less the bare minimum result, even with lots of marketing preparation. It was honestly a bit hard on me the first few days, since this is a game I've solo developed for a really long while, but...

[b]That's fine![/b] Because-

A) There's some great people already playing Netherguild; I've gotten excellent feedback for improving it since release which only makes me even more confident about the future of this game.

B) Speaking of which, it seems like a lot of you are really enjoying the game! From your feedback & reviews, the core gameplay loop is solid and enjoyable. Now it's time to polish everything else to work smoothly and add even more fun things to discover!

C) Netherguild was also... very buggy on release week - so in some ways I'm glad not as many players suffered from these issues. Most common bugs are fixed now, but there's still some things I want to add & fix this week (expanded on below).

Also, again - I'm finishing Netherguild regardless. There was a point in development when I was about to release with far less wishlists & much less of guarantee the game will do well financially, so I feel in some way I was prepared for this (:

[u]This is just the beginning! [/u]
Netherguild is going to be in early access for the next few years - early access release is only the first on many steps along that road.
I plan addressing a lot of player suggestions during development too - which will serve to improve it even further, and have it do even better on big update releases, let alone the full release!

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

As you might have seen, I've spent the last week bugfixing -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/067e36af8d78c54b9708a89300d8d770384e9445.png[/img]
[i]And that's not even everything...[/i]

[b]So what's fixed?[/b] In summary - [b]the most common crashes and loading errors[/b] that I know of have been fixed, as well as many other things.
(There is a single crash caused by descending that isn't fixed yet - but it doesn't persist on reloading the game. I'm also on it!)

[u]If you have a save that couldn't be loaded before, feel free to try to re-load it again! Most if not all "broken saves" should work fine now.[/u]

...

Oh yeah, bugfix updates in the future will likely not be as... incredibly numerous as they were this week (should often be part of bigger updates), it's just that a lot of the issues this week have been causing crashes & save issues, so for me as a dev it's important to have as few people suffer from them as possible.

[h2]How can you help?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/94dd3ee191361e688fca00af5d82b83fad71b74c.png[/img]
[i]The very first review of Netherguild from last week![/i]

[b]Review it:[/b] If you enjoyed Netherguild, write a Steam review! This is the best way to tell the Steam algorithm as well as other players that Netherguild is fun.
If you're waiting for a certain feature or fix to be added, feel free to wait until it's added and review the game afterwards! (:

[b]Play it:[/b] Other things that help are just playing the game - if you encounter any bugs and issues or if you have any feedback at all, sending it in-game, posting about it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1464220/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] or in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Discord[/url] help a ton too.

[b]Share it:[/b] Share it with friends who enjoy similar games &  your favorite streamers / youtubers!


[h1]The Week of Listening to Feedback[/h1]
[b]This week[/b], I plan on working on player requested fixes & improvements!

[i]Specifically...[/i]

[list]
[*][strike]Adding [b]Steam cloud saves[/b][/strike] (Done! added cloud saves on the 5th)
[*][strike][b]Fixing room generation[/b] issue where players are blocked out of progressing or getting to certain enemies[/strike] (Done! room generation fixed on the 10th of April).
[*]Fixing control re-binding with WASD & arrow keys and making it available in-dungeon and in the overworld too (Controls re-mapping fixed on the 6th, not available in dungeon & overworld yet)
[*]Fixing a variety of other smaller crashes, visual bugs etc.
[/list]

Will update you on the progress with these in next week's update!

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Content is the lifeblood of Netherguild - I'm dying to add more;

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3722828071300970020?l=english

[i]As I mentioned last week[/i], after I'm hopefully done with all the remaining fixes & improvements this week, I plan to start work on adding more enemies, oddities, character skills and equipment - including completely new stuff and deepening existing content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ee2415c0197b8b7ab06b3d2c35c96d1981eb4d10.gif[/img]

And that's all for this update - see you next Monday / Tuesday. Thank you for reading!

-David

Hey Guild Leaders!
Welcome to the January monthly update.

This update is a tad bit late - however, it's also a [u]big update[/u]! Including news from both January and December. Let's get into it!

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/41fd608c428fcdeb7f43f28c8a67bd5e75e05a72.gif[/img]
The bandit armorer uses his masterful smithing skills to [b]buff [/b]other bandits enemies or [b]debuff [/b]your units with a "weaken" status - reducing your melee damage! Watch out for deadly combos of him buffing bandit archers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/6b17372c9b45536c4902eaa1a557a74e0233f444.gif[/img]
I've also added three variants of the grub - these will be more powerful and rarer than the common variety. These are, from left to right: [b]Armored grub, Regenerating grub, Growing grub[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Regenerating grubs[/b] heal every turn yet deal very little damage, being persistent little buggers that are tough to kill. 
[*] [b]Growing grubs[/b] increase in size, health and damage every turn (up to a limit). It's better get rid of them early on!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/6d8f931a3e749add2f682596cc2ff10a0f2ae9df.gif[/img]
[b]Armored grubs[/b] have a rolling attack where they gain block and push your characters - so don't dilly dally near the edge! or you will be pushed off...

These next two enemies have been animated - I plan to add them to the lower floors of [i]The City of Mist[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0f01e1e56bb8d0c3090b84d0a369e495ece9f397.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9a1220f1afb95b373c978be7adb163f7393c4d9c.gif[/img]

I've also been working on lots of new equipment;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5323e20ae47f5b498037a86bf466972e8f069087.gif[/img]
Like these flashy crossbow boots! Which were originally a community suggestion by Blonde.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e95d8befe809fb63800f6a8f50475607ea23dac8.gif[/img]
It's also been a lot of fun fleshing out the new [i]City of Mist[/i] loot - and figuring out specific items which should prove handy in this dangerous, forgotten location.

[h2]New Menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a9e7f140a2953a298ab0368613bc918444845844.gif[/img]
A custom main menu for early access release!!
And if you prefer the older main menu or want to take another glimpse at it after release, you can always toggle to it via the new arrows in the bottom right of the screen (:

[h2]Trailer Draft[/h2]

Current draft of the Early Access trailer!
What do you think? is there anything you'd like me to add, remove or change? (:

[h2]One step away...[/h2]
We're getting really close to the Early Access release! I still have a ton to do - even more playtesting, steam preparations, and a bit more new content and enemies >:D at the same time, I'm so excited for it to happen - I hope you are too!!

notes.title: Netherguild's New Year Progress and Plans 2023
notes.content:
Hey guild leaders! 
For the new year, I wanted to share some of what I worked on in 2022 and my plans for 2023 and beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c3d6068bc31f864fa281714e35b92acd0f8181c9.png[/img]
[i]Bossfight against "pig", the leader of the purple bandits. No, he doesn't say "happy new year" in-game[/i]

[h1]2022 Overview[/h1]

Some of the new additions this year include:

[list]
[*]Steam Demo
[*]Initial upgrading system for buildings in the overworld
[*]Improved inventory screen
[*]Vastly improved loot
[*]Visual effects that make Netherguild look amazing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1f33eb7c2d4dbef841e7ca7fd875481b2842f173.png[/img]
[*]A whole lot of bugfixes, quality of life improvements and more, thanks to the community! <3
[/list]

In the full upcoming version:
[list]
[*]A system for "pits" - will let you push enemies (or be pushed) into a lower floor!
[*]The Bandit Stronghold - a new area with a bossfight, 3 unique non-boss enemies (so far, possibly more before / after release), and 4 oddities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e2a166b8ecc2a11a47af9a07e5245e9e9491364e.png[/img]
[i]The living quarters of bandits - various oddities will appear here.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e40cad265ea507be8be9318d030ac2271701b17e.gif[/img]
[i]A bandit fire-breather - watch out for these guys in prolonged fights.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4532b9fc49064daa8725dc2f0a191d476d03d2f7.gif[/img]
[i]"Help!" Will you save this poor stranded soul?[/i]

[*]The city of Mist - a new area with 7 unique enemies (more being worked on!), 5 oddities, unique equipment and the "Mist" itself - a tough environmental hazard!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a28b9b75ae00066b9a8df792ad8cf589c31b6e77.gif[/img]
[i]A machine guardian has been defeated[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4c7702fe236f5ae02d1c42d5bf55072a8a6828a4.gif[/img]
[i]Bridges that swing in subterranean wind[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a0d3edeaf0aaf034f3d62aded776eb2b27f761f7.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Early Access Release[/h1]
I really wanted to release Netherguild in early access this year... but, I had to delay it, since the early access content wasn't yet on the same level as the content of the demo area (the bluestone mines).

And - I'm glad I delayed it! a lot of the awesome stuff I have planned for the early access release possibly wouldn't have been there had I released too early.

[u]I'm currently planning to release Netherguild in Early Access around February / March of 2023![/u]

I don't have a date set in stone since there's still many things to do: for example, adding even more content and enemies to the game, polishing Netherguild to avoid a few common complaints on release, and creating a trailer!

But all in all, for what it counts, I'm hyped to see players discover all the new stuff I've been working on for the release version :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c6fa33fadaedf9d3f70e804a2f82e68fd4c89166.gif[/img]

[h1]
Fin
[/h1]
And that's all for this yearly update!! Thank you for checking it out.
If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know in the comments or in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Discord[/url], where I post regular weekly updates.
Hope you have an amazing 2023!!!

-David Vinokurov

notes.title: October 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey Guild Leaders! Welcome to the October monthly post. This one has some big news and more progress on the new areas!

Without further ado, here's some of what I've been working on this month:

[h2]Delayed release date[/h2]

I decided to [u]delay the early access release of Netherguild to around February 2023.[/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/5348612868501339833
I talk about it more in the post above, but the main gist of it is that this delay will give me time to add all the new content, to polish and playtest it properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2cab2ee3efeea55c08d47941ef667fcd40543c50.gif[/img]

[h2]More Enemies[/h2]

I've worked on adding more enemies to the new areas! (The City of Mist and Bandit Stronghold)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/affd9343c52db9a1769b52a8865a4be26592d6d7.gif[/img]

These wind-up automatons will be found on many rooftops. They will be powerful and tanky, yet slow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/62c8eef8e3385228e67baa4edef635a58fcec5ae.gif[/img]

Explosive bandits are not suicide bombers! Rather, they're tanky units which attack tight knit formations. Spread out your units to avoid their wrath!

They'll also explode after being defeated... but more on that later in the post (;

[h2]Sound Effects[/h2]

I've also worked on fleshing out some of the enemies I posted last month-

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3292718815232067815
-which will now have their very own custom sound effects! Have a listen:

[previewyoutube=jiWFVCsYQ7o;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=exXl3i5bng4;full][/previewyoutube]

Isn't the "hit" sound of the poison shot just so... wet and disgusting? I LOVE it :D

[h2]Boss Battle[/h2]

If you remember the words of a certain [b]drunk bandit[/b], he speaks of the leader of the bandits - a fella nicknamed "Pig". 
Step through the gauntlet that is the Bandit Stronghold, and he'll be right there, waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8fafbb295ba9c2cbc69a1a6e174c713981b635d0.gif[/img]

Oh yeah, 10 HP is only for playtesting - expect the bandit leader to have more.
And multiple phases.

But don't worry, you won't be fighting alone...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/75286fab21b9c56b1c869f0396b8819b9198d2c4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c6fa33fadaedf9d3f70e804a2f82e68fd4c89166.gif[/img]

There's going to be an in-house audience! Which is going to be fighting you too. But more on that next update.

[h2]Misc.[/h2]

I've also worked on various other things for Netherguild this month!

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]

Did you ever spend a little... too much time fiddling with clicking on the exit elevator?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/00a733f67ad76b089816c5cebe36181a7e771eea.gif[/img]

I added a fix so that every "second click" on the elevator out of combat, all your units will get on it.
(second click meaning - traveling the elevator when a character is already there)

Should make exploring just a tiny bit more comfortable!

[h3]Danger Tiles[/h3]
Since I will need to telegraph certain attacks during the bossfight, I figured it was time... to add "danger tiles!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3b74a1859a1c1c71c5c686d4fa26a9e284f689dd.gif[/img]

And what better way to test it than... with the explosive bandit?
It would be fun to explore these "danger tiles" with some special hazards in future areas too.

[h3]Mist City Elevator[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/99da36832b346f3a504c3493925b9426325bd805.png[/img]
Locomotion and the exits from different floors might look different! Since it doesn't make sense to use the same good ol' gray mining elevator everywhere.
Therefore... prepare to board this strange, cramped transport elevator for The City of Mist instead.

[h2]Until next time...[/h2]

And that's all for this update! Thank you for checking it out :D I'm pretty excited to show off more of the bandit boss fight next month.
Cheers, and have a great November!

-David

notes.title: September 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey Guild Leaders! This month I worked a lot on the new areas.

Without further ado, here's some of what I've been working on during September.

[h2]New Areas[/h2]

This month, I worked a lot on the new areas for early access - these two areas are:

1. The Bandit Stronghold

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d086c5996b73ef3d6abfd798f6f09a9577e92adf.png[/img]

2. The City of Mist

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7ceca87fc2741e5519e3c5ecc4f9722522a5bea4.png[/img]

With both of these areas, I've tried making them appear like they're places people live in (or used to live in, in the case of the city of mist).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c3efa2464b6c4f290bf86b99e0b14fcafca6910d.png[/img]

Automatons will patrol the forgotten rooftop markets... (work-in-progress)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/90bd6dcd73dce79c0612dd86f40f4c5af2ebd3fb.png[/img]

Vines of lichen will creep up the walls, while gears litter the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e2a166b8ecc2a11a47af9a07e5245e9e9491364e.png[/img]

And oddities might appear in the bandit's living quarters...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c9d4b7d93733de89c6f550c34b1208f38716bd39.gif[/img]

(And [b]yes[/b], you [b]can [/b]shoot the targets)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/cd378b1385d573e9d0298e31922492ca7f2b7411.gif[/img]

Walking alongside the edge will make tiny bits of the towers fall below, reminding you of the danger of falling -
or making for a dramatic effect when one is pushed off the edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4c7702fe236f5ae02d1c42d5bf55072a8a6828a4.gif[/img]

Bridges also animate (alongside with whomever is standing on top of them).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/eef29b4ce739882e7499ae131db6ea813b685898.png[/img]

[h2]Mist System[/h2]

A vicious natural phenomena will affect your expeditions into the forgotten city of mist area - that is, the mist itself!

When descending a floor, you'll be greeted by a "weather prediction" - 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d671781f90ebead365bc1599155e9d45e7a9d3d9.png[/img]

Forecasting the mist in that area.

Every certain amount of combat rounds, the mist will rise up! It will stay there for a couple of turns and obscure your vision.

[previewyoutube=Md7ijLZjv7M;full][/previewyoutube]

It will pretty much "turn off" the vision of your non-current units.

On top of that, every time you start your turn in the mist, it'll rotate your character randomly and move them to an adjacent tile you can step on.

[previewyoutube=wMLlPsOLuJE;full][/previewyoutube]

When you do discover a unit, ally or enemy through the mist, they'll stay there for the reminder of your turn (not round).

[i][b]WAIT! THAT SUCKS, THOUGH?[/b][/i]
It totally does! The mist is an environmental hazard, and it turns combat into an information-gathering game.
But... there's ways to counter it, and upsides!!

For example...
- It only stays for a few rounds, so you can always wait it out. Maybe an ok option for defensive builds is stalling this way.
- High movement builds let you scout around better and discover enemies / allies and set up attacks.
- It can be countered to a limited degree with the "track" ability
- The "burn" status effect counters it to an extent too by appearing through the mist

[i]The mist might be keeping something worse at bay, too...[/i]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]

I've started working on the enemies for the new area this month too!
Among them, two interesting ones are;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7f037830ebff1a3427b518956d9c9137b82c107b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/15c26ea84e98f488aafb9b0d407d60d1640ace81.gif[/img]

The "hungry grubs" - part of the mist moth hives. These little creatures swarm to your position. Even if they deal small damage and have low health, they're can become a real danger by cornering and overwhelming your characters with their numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5a9bcb88246da19aa3fecb71642f828d4c371b3e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/fb0c21d335eb93e3d1b26c18cca0a9091870309f.gif[/img]

The "spitter grub" is going to spit weak but long poison at your characters from afar!
Poison activates when attacking, so if this spitter grub has support, getting rid of them (especially using "free action" abilities) becomes tougher. 
On top of that, it'll slow your characters down, making reaching this enemy and stopping them tougher.
Its main weaknesses are its limited range and limited movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a08b994f10fc1ad0d6222166fc62ae02ac88dbbc.gif[/img]

I've been working on other enemies too, which I'll post about at the next update in about a month from now (:

[h2]Composer[/h2]

After a long process of interviewing multiple composers and asking them for demo tracks for Netherguild, I teamed up with the extremely talented Daniele "Elrehon" Coppola! 

[previewyoutube=hEvTZVeXX0M;full][/previewyoutube]

This is his demo submission for the bandit stronghold's soundtrack.

[h2]Notable Mentions...[/h2]

There's more things I worked on this month! Since I can't fit everything from the weekly [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url], I figured I'd drop a few honorable mentions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0d9aab25e3906e154156a1ac858c011259b41a18.png[/img]
Shooting from (or towards) a high-up tile will work differently to how shooting is normally done - it's tougher to shoot higher tiles from below (so you can only really shoot the ledge).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/55c7eb47452fdb96545748d56cf435bddfcd4291.png[/img]

This means heightened tiles give much needed tactical freedom to ranged characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/fec82c277099c6121f68505fd95337824aa2546c.gif[/img]
"Air canisters" are an idea I've been toying with for the city of mist - 
They'd work a bit like explosive barrels, but instead of dealing damage, they just push units away when exploding.
This opens up the way to new strategies like attacking gas canisters with melee characters or pushing the canisters themselves, for a deadly combo that eventually pushes an enemy off the ledge, down to the next floor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8726754c40033b3fd5414d5458fa6a8104a6f4ef.png[/img]

Netherguild will also take part in the Dreamhack steam event in the middle of October! An updated demo might arrive before or around that time too (if I find time between all the work on the new areas!).

Also, welcome to all the new guild leaders who found about about Netherguild from the Tacticon event last month! Glad to have you here :D

[h2]The end[/h2]

And that's all for this update! What a productive month.
Thank you for checking it out, I hope it made for a fun read :D
Cheers and have a great October!

-David

notes.title: August 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey Guild Leaders! This month I worked a lot on the new areas.

Without further ado, here's some of what I've been working on during August.

[h2]Procedural Tile Heights[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c996d5f8679b7ef33f19e3627ba7307b55718060.png[/img]

The first step to making tile-height matter in gameplay: Having significant tile height difference! Here's another example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1df8dd70c63104a99d3d6e0be4b9c267e7ef51fe.png[/img]

[b]But...[/b] that caused some issues with the mouse-aiming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/fad20027c035af998004ed61619cd52baf1e4a85.gif[/img]

So I had to re-do the system for it (it uses proper colliders now!):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f1f365481be5c8e9d374f34105324fc4e4b547c1.png[/img]

Should be much better now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0f252430d37ca763deb54fec24bcebe4d25369d5.gif[/img]

[h2]Procedural Stairs[/h2]

Continuing the trend of procedural additions, I added stairs that get generated in the new floor this week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/686f4857db61e247e1a52409c7142ccfd4301c3f.png[/img]

These should serve as natural chokepoints and should help make navigating the new floors more interesting.

[h2]Pushing with tiles of different Heights[/h2]

While messing around in the new areas, I noticed something uncanny...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/366e209c5aae2d51c06ed76e922b5859d7c00c5a.gif[/img]

I don't have to be an expert to tell you that this is [b]NOT[/b] how pushing should look!

So I fixed it - walls are now proper obstacles for pushed units:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3f8d53db8e31f541ac4c72dd6098a07bb3da42ee.gif[/img]

I also thought a bit about pushing enemies from higher platform to lower ones -
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/50f1cc3ba0ae8818e7672dd24fb92f9371c2be27.gif[/img]

I figured it'd be pretty fun if they receive damage when dropping from a certain height - the rule here is similar to damage when pushing off a unit, the damage they receive is equal to a quarter of their max health.

But... what if they drop onto an obstacle? or another unit? I obviously can't have two units in the same tile...

So how about they just [b]bounce?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/6e567fbe8fe47ef661519eb145a1165a516e6b21.gif[/img]

[h2]Visuals & Fog[/h2]

In addition to all the procedural generation stuff, I also worked on the visuals of the new areas this month (you can see other versions of the visuals in the #wip channel in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url]).

Here's a mockup of how it'll look with enemies:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c8610c073a6af704241159ea43e7884eabc9bc95.png[/img]

You may have noticed the fog (the red squares around the tiles!) a gray, impenetrable fog will have an effect on gameplay in the Mist City where the fog is denser, but for the Bandit Stronghold the red fog is purely visual.

[h2]Planning Out The Entire Game[/h2]

Every Sunday I reflect on my work that week and plan out the future of Netherguild -
This month I finished planning out the outline of the ENTIRE GAME.
This is an outline of more or less all the floors (actual levels or 'camp' floors) that I plan for Netherguild 1.0 to have on full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e1c59dc39c75c6e0970fd974f032c763367f3845.png[/img]

[i](Of course, subject to changes, removals and additions, but this is the general outline)[/i]

[h2]Release Date?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/06036a5a4b75f1e7aecd322c0c86c15f9000daa3.png[/img]
Originally, I wanted to release Netherguild earlier - but with the amount of content I still want to add (like finishing the two new floors, adding a bossfight) before Early Access release, I ended up changing my plans to release it sometime during November this year.

[h2]- Until Next Time -[/h2]

And that's all for this update! Thank you for checking it out, hope it made for a fun read :D
Cheers and see you next time!!

-David

notes.title: July 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Guild Leaders! here's some of what I've added to Netherguild during July.
This is a big update, so let's get into it!

[h2]Status Effect Improvements[/h2]

Something that irked me a bit in the past was status effects being all too similar to one another (for example Burn, Bleed and Poison just dealing damage over time).

So I decided to add some extra flavor to Burn and Poison...

[h3]Fire Increases Visibility[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8fa08b1e00b10ea684a667030deb92dfefa3ef5a.gif[/img]
And functions as a double edged sword - giving you more information about the battlefield, but perhaps attracting the unwanted attention of far-away enemies!

[h3]Fire Spreads[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/08a0d70baab9c89e0b4be428ea16dd595e1c55bf.gif[/img]
When a unit is afflicted by "burn"- if it's alive after receiving status damage, the "burn" status spreads to adjacent units in its vicinity.

Why is this great?
[list]
[*]Makes fire-based builds feel a lot more interesting and unique
[*]Turns burning units into hazards; perhaps incapcitating a burning enemy keeps it safely far away from you, or having to step away from a burning enemy keeps the battlefield more dynamic.
[*]Fighting a burning unit in melee for too long is bad, seeing how you'll end up recieving the status yourself and getting damage until combat ends or the status expires!
[*]Unexpected creativity - things like adding "burn" to an enemy adjacent to an explosive barrel to ignite it!
[/list]

[h3]Poison Triggers After Attacking Too[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a0deab5f8ce64be1da53c3353a37b5341e7dfaa6.gif[/img]
This makes poison a very powerful status effect - dealing damage twice per turn for most attacking characters.

[i]However...[/i]
This should also make things more interesting as a counter to builds or enemies that use "free action" abilities - using too many free actions in a row with a long poison will have its toll on them, health-wise, unless protected from poison by equipment for example.

It also gives the player an "escape" - not attacking when poisoned would help conserve character health at times.

[h2]Falling System Complete[/h2]
You may remember the falling system from a previous updates...
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3187993730659010317
This month it's 100% done!

When enemies or allies die while falling to the next floor, their loot or items can be recovered there. For example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7ac14bc5f5d7fa012f5b66085983c45c74cae1a1.gif[/img]
[i]Assassin dies while pushed to the next floor[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7dcae0634555bfb8ebc3e3c50e217d3ce6c16e37.gif[/img]
[i]All of his items & equipment can be recovered from his corpse at the next floor.[/i]

Of course, allies that survive being pushed to the next floor can be rescued (as mentioned before).
This system will be important in the new areas being added for early access - the [b]Bandit Stronghold[/b] and [b]Mist City[/b].

[h2]Quality of Life Additions[/h2]
A few small improvements make managing your expeditions far easier! such as:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/70298f40d3ef6b77408257998b551d08f2e702c5.gif[/img]
[b]Automatic resting[/b] which makes characters adjacent to the bonfire rest next to it automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0486779706c93cdfd181a59113a4a1337d205b81.gif[/img]
Can "quick send" items between containers & characters using [b]shift-click[/b] (also appears in the tutorial now).

[h2]Procedural Generation Fixes[/h2]
When playing, some players would get blocked by the procedural generation of levels - objects would appear where they shouldn't and prevent you from progressing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e984a2c7dc4ac82d3ede80edd4675f6e5f1fe43c.png[/img]

This was an even more prominent issue on the new floors - where maps would generate with some rooms completely cut off.

Technically there was a system set up to prevent that, but it was a 3-4 year old system at this point - and worse, it was completely broken.

So I added a new one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/74a6a73b249aeb8690fd1621d143d7fc2fcbd1a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b2e8948f7637c9d4e7605af6fb642dd155c40fc8.png[/img]
[i]Or click the thumbnails for bigger image size:[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/74a6a73b249aeb8690fd1621d143d7fc2fcbd1a4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1764bf52ae02d3ff5a9ca3ce65adaaf78f3a2fc1.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b2e8948f7637c9d4e7605af6fb642dd155c40fc8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a5081df1b499e0228505b42f880b81eac627177a.png[/img][/url]

It makes a "path" using some simple vector math and prevents any tile blocking objects (like crates or barricades) from spawning there.

The issue, however, is that updating the game with it will mess up in-dungeons saves, so I I'll likely delay it for a bigger update in a week or few from now.

Speaking of which...

[h2]Updates & Up Next[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d65fe8665f59a891f9903a7f8cfcf066e6f33301.png[/img]
[b]Working on Tile Heights[/b]
Originally I didn't plan for tile height to affect gameplay, but, inspired by the 3D concept art I made (picture above) I decided to add it to Netherguild. It'll be difficult and take a decent amount of time to add, but at the same time I'm really excited for it (and for pushing enemies off high platforms!).

[b]Big update coming up[/b]
It will include the level-generation fix mentioned here as well as new and improved daggers, and other changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d1929f6183f661a915059b0586d781a0b0e77ace.png[/img]
[b]Tacticon[/b]
This is a big event on Steam which I'm excited to take part of, later in September! Netherguild has already been accepted to the event and will participate alongside other great strategy games.

[h2]And that's all... for now![/h2]
Thank you for checking out the update! Hope it made for a fun read.
See you next time! (:

-David

notes.title: June 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Guild Leaders! I bring you the newest progress on Netherguild from June.
This month I worked on the new areas, added some new content, and participated in Steam's next fest.

Lets get into it!

[h2]New Areas[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/6076cbb49919658f36c7c27cf3c8330275ae3e25.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7d87fc61b8f96c55e0c3b9ce01353aed71ea7ade.png[/img]
The (work in progress) bandit stronghold is really starting to look a lot more like the 3D concept model of it I posted in earlier updates!

I get further into the process of how it was made over on the Netherguild Discord, but in short: different towers have slightly different height, side spikes were added, bridges now hang neatly between towers and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0553a9e266306baf6cc9b56f57d01f6d4c55f478.png[/img]

What a satisfying arc - maybe it would be fun to have these sway from side to side as your expedition members cross them.

Concept for reference:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8fb7ea77443c6480565d082592891d3a528234b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ce4ddc66755876a8ab4d31361ff96a1525eee84b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/806664bb10f364729f8f6ebcbc9d76164d1aa778.png[/img]
A few of the new enemies all rigged and ready to be animated!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/44cdb51cb24d4ad7297ad4b9297f09601c9f165f.gif[/img]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
To spice up the game for players re-visiting Netherguild in the Next Fest, I added some rare rooms you might encounter on the third floor...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/09d63dc72bd24e82891c9053f648d73125d86eb8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e64a69cc0658990a2b5a769b0b6ff69c36ffc316.png[/img]

One of them is a room with many bandits but three chests... as well as well spaced obstacles in between to make zoning out enemies and fighting them more viable.

The other is a room with shrimp nests and two big shrimps... you might want to think twice about stealing their eggs, they will get angry!

[h2]Overworld Gets Tougher Over Time[/h2]
If you've descended more than three times for lengthy underground expeditions with the demo, you might have noticed this message!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5d97ae00460388ba345fd9619b57e04ccee3f18a.png[/img]

The idea is that the overworld is going to get chaotic over time, so the player is fighting a somewhat invisible timer - with shortages, price increases and theft that become more harsh over the course of many expeditions... and eventually the plague itself.

However, there are also going to be many opportunities and random events that help you combat these ever-increasing challenges.

[h2]Some less major stuff...[/h2]
There was also some less major stuff I worked on this month:

[h2]Trap Buff[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/864862fcdea2e663633a178990f4c952c5358c95.gif[/img]
Rangers and Assassins can now move one tile away after placing trap-type abilities! This helps them get away from would-be attackers.

[h2]Quality of Life Additions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7e4fc0f9eb0244857cfde6b1c213d4fe067a014d.gif[/img]
You can now click to switch to a character out of combat! It should make exploration underground a lot easier.

Not only that, you can now build bonfires with [b]all characters[/b] as long as someone has logs, instead of having to shuffle to find the one character who does.

I plan to work on more of these quality of life additions during July, to try and make the experience of exploring and managing your guild as smooth as possible.

[h2]Events[/h2]
Thank you for playing the game during next fest!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7291d479b652d65b275f69abdb8764d2d75d84ef.png[/img]

You might have noticed some of the streams on the steam page during the fest - these ended up being a lot of fun.
Expect more possible streams during the Tiny Teams event on August!*
*Edit: Netherguild didn't get accepted to Tiny Teams this year, but do expect more streams in future events (:

[h2]-Welcome back, guild leader!-[/h2]

And that's all for this update! Hope it made for a fun read and thank you for checking it out.
See you next time! (:

-David

notes.title: May 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Guild Leaders! Here's some of what I've been working on in May.
It includes new content, new loot, and new systems in the works. 

HYPE!

[h2]Visual Effects[/h2]

If you haven't read about the new visual effects yet, here's a link to a post where I explain more about it:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3187997689890117288
[b]The tldr;[/b] Nice visual effects that are completely optional - they are enabled automatically on every visual setting besides the lowest one, but can be changed in the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/821ffa4637ce62d08a9da27a60469e90a1829de1.png[/img]

[h2]New & Upgraded Loot[/h2]
This month, I rebalanced [b]almost all[/b] the items you can find in chests and in the armory.
Making armors and weapons stronger and more valuable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2b2d84761f8b0aada198e672e786592984282bc4.png[/img]

I redid my code so that now I can add a lot of "if x, do y" mechanics to attacks easily - and used it to spice up a lot of the existing equipment to be more interesting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8da2d906924b313fd838a92cf1f13f8426ca87a0.png[/img]

Another change is spicing up existing armor, so it's always an upgrade compared to the starter gear and more fun to use -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/73204abab37b3e307b0c734058e6bda9e6daa3c2.png[/img]

[i]Finally, I also added a new heavy armor, a new light armor, and new boots - while removing one dagger.[/i]

[h2]New Systems![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4ca30bb42eee9a1574aa9ecd86c34ffa10c44118.gif[/img]
[h3]Building Upgrading[/h3]
It is what it says on the box - this will let you upgrade your buildings in the overworld for increase capacity, utility, etc.
It's not 100% finished yet but it's getting close to done.

Not only does it give players a way to convert their coins into added utility in the overworld, it's also a method for adding new functionality to exiting buildings!

In the future I also want it to be more of a skill-tree, with some upgrades unlocking over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/63024384da665ea8e6f98f48cd06129ac200e273.png[/img]
[h3]Hidden Talents[/h3]
What if every time a character leveled up and you picked a new skill for them, 
there would be a 15% chance that they'd get a [u]modified and slightly more powerful[/u] version of this skill, with some sort of a [u]random upgrade[/u]?
[i]Be it a few more uses between rests, a damage up, increased range, status or utility?[/i]

The idea is that it'd make for some characters that have unique skills that are perhaps more memorable - players could get more attached to them too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b5c2dbfb5fbfd3e428cf7899a419b10face477f1.png[/img]

This is a system I haven't added yet, though I have it thoroughly planned out so it'd be a relatively easy addition - of course it'd also mean adding a bunch of chance modifications to each skill.

[b]How do [u]you[/u] feel about it? Is it exciting, or not so much? let me know![/b]

Expect dev streams, streamers playing the game, and a lot more - if you have a favorite streamer, please tell them to check out the game during next fest too!

I hope you're as excited about this as I am :D
