notes.title: April 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Steam readers! Here's some of what I've been working on in April.
It includes [u]Fixes and Improvements[/u], some of my initial work on the [u]New Areas[/u] and more!


[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
I planned to spend most of April fixing Netherguild! This is because there were some things that needed urgent fixing - for example, the tutorial windows appearing in distracting moments and issues with the inventory - as well as some things I just wanted to fix and improve in preparation for the Steam festivals in summer.

Some of these additions were player-requested, too!

[b]Small Screen Support[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/842a8dbd8189d63642a77c81f1cd8a04348fd941.png[/img]
If you played Netherguild with a screen slimmer than 1920 pixels wide, or, heavens forbid, less than 1600 pixels wide, you were in for a tough time and I don't envy you. A lot of the UI was incredibly messy and uncomfortable for players with small screens.

Well, not anymore! I spent a weekend going over every single thing at 1366x768 resolution to make sure the game is not only playable but also looks and feels good at smaller resolutions. It even includes custom features like this [i]sliding character roster UI[/i] that [i]only appear on smaller resolutions[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1ed53fdae8a43b0a7e6825656bcd7de342783cf8.gif[/img]

[b]Middle Mouse Camera Dragging[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/59cb6b48e7bd89f3820abb4eadffc2c8747c60ac.gif[/img]
A feature that has been requested by many players before (specifically I remember Rale from the Discord asking for it).
Now that I've added I can't do without it - it left me wondering... why didn't I add it before?...
[i]Oh well, better late than never!![/i] (:

[b]Movement Counter[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/18f997049b3a015f5aed0d57ea3217243dd82310.png[/img]
Can you spot it on the right side of the screen?

It should be handy in helping players navigate! I remember a friend of mine (Conan) asking for this as well as a user named CBrauto using the in-game feedback.

[b]Visual Coins Improvement[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5a4c936d622779e96bf71a6b247978a829a4efc0.gif[/img]
In the past, if coins were in the same tile as an enemy or loot, it'd end up looking pretty messy...
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/bccaaaa54bcff847316153b19dbfe56f3c58fae1.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/bccaaaa54bcff847316153b19dbfe56f3c58fae1.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Well, not anymore.[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a8e1ad1bbf81fb45d96f139d9b62cff50edf8091.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/a8e1ad1bbf81fb45d96f139d9b62cff50edf8091.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Smooth Camera[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5d12b204844eb4ca26ee9a0fb984ae7a2f0732f0.gif[/img]
The camera smoothly re-focuses on the current character when attacking. I was convinced this would be annoying at first but it just feels so... satisfying, for some reason.

I also worked on many other small fixes to make playing the game more comfortable to play - feel free to fire up the demo if you haven't in the last month to see what changed!


[h2]New Areas[/h2]

Early infographics, showcasing my plans for the new areas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2366803691eb97cd1313214a8cf4a20b47d33063.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/da396308326f0d1f43d9cf35e6e9e61477e9eedf.png[/img]

Here's some other tidbits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/81e33da65ac3a80dd9ff6f76d5ea972b25f239cb.png[/img]
[i]The title text of the bandit stronghold![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f159c7256301dad111cad6a83b58105603c1d107.gif[/img]
[i]The tin men will have a windup key on their back...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/6c664fe663987ef6d557f20f47c2ee25e0a1cacb.png[/img]
I just started adding the new areas into engine this week, so this screenshot is extremely raw! But over time these bridges will hang at a satisfying arc, torches will light the walls, and bandits will eagerly await you with readied weapons...

[h2]Big Events[/h2]
[previewyoutube=c-YzO-0iwJs;full][/previewyoutube]
Indie youtuber Splattercat tried out Netherguild! I was completely surprised when this happened... but it seems like he liked it! Also, welcome to all the Splattercat viewers who joined us since!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c51383e932bb3b0697471cc1e59e211f7cc56521.png[/img]

Netherguild is also participating in Steam's [b]"Going Rogue"[/b] festival!! It is pretty tough to find it among the other thousand (or more) titles in the event, but it seems like some people did (:

I did livestream when the event started which ended up being a ton of fun - so if you missed it out, do expect more of these in future events.

[h2]Next Up[/h2]
I plan on improving the demo's [b]content[/b] in preparation for [b]Steam's summer fest[/b]!! This means...

[list]
[*]Balance pass on all items and skills, making them more fun
[*]New mechanics for attacks and abilities
[*]New equipment
[/list]
I'm excited to add some new systems too, and perhaps add more speech lines to player and enemy characters... but I don't want to make any promises I'm unsure I can keep with regards to these, so expect to read more about them in next month's update instead (;

I'm also going to continue working on the new areas - expect to see more in-engine stuff in next month's update. 
In addition to that, I will keep fixing and improving Netherguild like I did in April, but I won't focus on it as much - seeing how I want to focus on CONTENT this month instead!

[h2]-Update End-[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/dd3a7c94dba3561635f40257231308a1e74c82b8.png[/img]
[i]A dark screenshot of a (now fixed) bug that made characters t-pose[/i]

That's all for this update! Thank you for reading and see you next time (:

-David

notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Steam denizens! Here's a glimpse into what I've been working on in March.

[h2]Steam Demo Release[/h2]

Last month I released Netherguild's Steam demo! Massive thank you to everyone who tried it out, left feedback, bug reports and kind words!!!

[b]Netherguild wouldn't have been the game it is today without the feedback you have given me along the way, so I can not overstate how much I appreciate it.[/b]

Right now we're standing at over [b]1K wishlists[/b] too!! Which is very impressive.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1464220/Netherguild/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/869985c9a5f319824349728da50186593f56ae4d.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Falling System[/h2]

This important system I mentioned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1464220/view/3099044462442215658]last update[/url] is even closer to done!

[i]Enemies and player characters can be pushed to the floor below:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/470272c0dbc800e23302dea7884b0f113a405c3f.gif[/img]


[i]But if a player character gets pushed to the floor below, they end up stranded and appear like this:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/530c0c4e847f4604a7d2163c23f881b27a8522c2.gif[/img]


[i]Until you rescue them:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/cebdff2487c12aa9337d2b0d3167c237edeff6e3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/80a21a935ca821d2968bd56edcd81c20c5e09f3a.gif[/img]


Of course, your time is limited, guild leader!... if you wait for too long and set out on multiple expeditions that fail to rescue, you might never see your fallen comrades again.

Your stranded guild members will also have a chance to [b]climb back up on their own[/b] depending on their level, so higher ranked characters might even save themselves... if you're lucky. (;


[h2]Inventory[/h2]

Inventory used to be a bit... uhm... iffy. Especially when it comes to dropping items with multiple inventories, which would create these empty windows for some reason all over the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/42ce5a6b8f5e4ceea4bd65c792c8743784143f57.gif[/img]

Not anymore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/e59b0780bffe8e2ccb098b7ed8cce61102fd6466.gif[/img]

Now if the current character drops an item, it'd always go to the displayed inventory in the center.
Dropped items from other characters will appear near their inventory window so you can quickly realize who they used to belong to.

Even more inventory and "quality of life" improvements are coming up in the near future! In fact...

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/cc657121a054da227483f9b546c44cbe1ea55bbb.png[/img]

Netherguild has been invited to [b]two[/b] Steam events in the near future!! 
Therefore, I decided that:

[b]1. This month (April)[/b], I'll focus on [b]polishing[/b] the demo even more with some of the feedback and suggestions you have given me, to make it an even more streamlined, comfortable and welcoming experience (in preparation for players trying it out during the events).

[b]2. The next few months (May-June)[/b] I'll focus on [b]improving and adding to the content[/b] in the demo. This will most likely include re-balancing some of the items to be more fun and interesting, as well as possibly adding new mechanics, new items and more. Expect me to rant more about it after I'll add it!




All throughout these months, I also plan to work on the two next areas in Netherguild, the [b]Bandit Stronghold[/b] and [b]City of Mist[/b]. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ce4ddc66755876a8ab4d31361ff96a1525eee84b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/c6af00a6dbc9f262eedc596ad6b4a9da3b2443d6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2a7906326ffd0a9107ef0609b475167fecbd77c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/722d26796bd924381a15ad50415947828de39e2d.png[/img][/url]

[h2]-Update End-[/h2]

-David

notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Steam peeps! Here's a glimpse into what I've been working on in February.

[h2]Upcoming Steam Demo[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0ae7eaa270b523b5b1656f6393c641e0f2c8ba03.png[/img]
I've been working recently on setting up a Steam demo of Netherguild! 
As many of you already know, [url=https://superobot1.itch.io/netherguild]Netherguild has had a demo on Itch.io[/url] for a long while now-

-[b]however[/b], setting up a Steam demo on top of that will let Netherguild participate in Steam festivals in the future, as well as letting more players and Streamers access the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/7f5d6205e930f06ff0112d210c1313dec523c727.png[/img]

On the Steam demo release day, the new demo will be the same as the Itch.io demo + a few small additions, improvements and fixes (an update will also be pushed out on Itch.io when it happens).

Also, big thank you to LRadikal and Daedrin on the Discord (as well as the rest of the Discord community) for helping me make sure that the Steam demo works properly on Linux!!

[h2]Walls & Pits Update[/h2]
As you might've noticed from some of the concepts for the new areas I posted before...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5ddba2884bba72cbc99d823b39df607e0b5c3d5a.png[/img]

The edges of these areas are basically a massive 'pit' - which brings us to the subject of this section, the 'walls and pits' update! 
[i]A brand new game mechanic that's being added to Netherguild...[/i]

The thing about pits, is that similarly to walls, players and enemies can't step on them, however, you can shoot over pits, and push units into them.

[i]Wait a second... pushing units into pits? just how would that work...?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/1b409cd96b807e889062d8dd3fc9752b5443e6f1.png[/img]

[u]What happens when a character falls into a pit:[/u]
First up, they receive fall damage equal to a percentage of their [b]max health[/b].

[b]Afterwards[/b], if they die, XP and effects are activated normally.

However, if fall damage isn't enough to kill them, they'll appear on the next floor below! 
Damaged and angry, in a random room.

This turns pushing enemies into a powerful "finisher" move (especially against higher HP enemies that can be pushed), or a "panic button", but overusing it can have negative consequences... (like missing out on loot or having way too many enemies pushed away to the floor blow you).

[u]What about fallen player characters?[/u]
I plan for them to appear as a sort of 'oddity' - as in, when approaching them you'd be able to choose to return them to the surface.
They might be able to join you if you have room, or fight alongside you if they dropped into an area with enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8fb201ec16ce2a806ca90226028556c31d2c7af1.gif[/img]

This system is still work-in-progress, I hope I'll be able to show you more of it next month!

[h2]Small UI improvements and more[/h2]

As I was wrapping up the update from last month, I added a bit of more polishing to the UI!

[b][u]Initiative[/u][/b]
Initiative order UI is looking snazzy with icons and shorter descriptions (to the right).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/4ba0794fc1af7f3faa1390ee7bd5eb770498a89b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/978191680003494c95e80883ef48eaa978633a4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/9d11b973673e2e6ecf5a72347575a6002af2bcdb.png[/img]

[b][u]Hiring screen[/u][/b]
I added this neat little effect for character hiring that looks a bit like drawing cards. 
It fits since characters have randomized backgrounds (and therefore some different skill trees, personalities and more) on top of the four current classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/d87e986194c26996ace2f168eb657c38ab90e1b5.gif[/img]

The effect appears every time there's new characters in the guild, or when you choose to randomize the character backgrounds.

[u][b]Bonus: Faster Bow Animations[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/0a25f41f7d22f38f0811884dd046b8b2995d3753.gif[/img]

Something that has been suggested by the Discord community and playtesters in general (which I frankly wanted to add myself as well) was shorter animations for bow-shooting!!

This doesn't apply to "special" animations like the "piercing arrow" ability but pretty much to all the regular bow-shooting ones.

[i](Big thank you to both Naucitos in the Discord and Zorder on G.Round, who I explicitly remember asked for this addition.)[/i]

[h2]-Update End-[/h2]

That's all for this update! Thank you for reading and see you next time (:

-David

notes.title: January 2022 Progress Update
notes.content:
[i]Summery of weekly updates over on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url][/i]

Hey Steam folks! Here's some of what I've been working on in January.

[h2]Major Improvements[/h2]
Over the course of time, these community requested features and changes were added:

[u][b]Equipment Comparison System[/b][/u]
When you find new loot, how can you know if it's better than your current equipment?
Before, the only option was either memorizing your equipment or slowly going over to check it.

Instead, I decided to add a system for easily comparing relevant equipment-!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/80d771f2cc2468b472a742f77843b2267c3ac61e.png[/img]

Here's how it looks like in the armory:
[previewyoutube=5c3B6zffxRc;full][/previewyoutube]
And here's how looks like in-dungeon:
[previewyoutube=C6tpDw01Um4;full][/previewyoutube]
Should be way more comfortable to use. [i]Now, do I equip that new item or not? hmm...[/i]

[u][b]Dungeon Inventory Redo[/b][/u]
Earlier in January and during last December, many players playtested Netherguild on G.Round - a few of them complained about the inventory screen being too messy and unclear.
[i]Especially when you open the shared inventory of all units...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2c1d22989c0e1e136dcfb57220d363e9685bae48.png[/img]
You might have felt that way after the last video too, and between you and I, those players were making a pretty convincing argument!
So in the next version of the demo (and all future version of Netherguild), inventory will look more like this:
[previewyoutube=X032Bgq0KOQ;full][/previewyoutube]
While looking a lot clearer and more stylish, I also made sure to optimize it a bit, by only animating the last character or container that was hovered over.
(Counting frames in the top right - don't worry, that's not part of the inventory)

[u][b]Hiring screen redo[/b][/u]
Netherguild's character hiring screen used to look... overwhelming and cumbersome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/b90a65bad444380d153467c3c0e54ed48749bcf8.png[/img]
But not anymore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/105f5c3e8a711ec312fab148ab1e8858dfc8812d.png[/img]

And here's a video of it in action:

[previewyoutube=WPkCbqJhM1Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Should be way smoother and better organized now.
It actually reminds me of character sheets in tabletop RPGs (like D&D, for example).
I might expand it in the future to show a character's starting equipment or skill tree too.

[u][b]New Concepts for New Areas[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ce4ddc66755876a8ab4d31361ff96a1525eee84b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/8fb7ea77443c6480565d082592891d3a528234b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/2a7906326ffd0a9107ef0609b475167fecbd77c1.png[/img]

This time, I'm experimenting with some verticality. 
I want each area in Netherguild to have a unique feeling, and a unique set of challenges -
Not only with enemies, but also with terrain and props, events and oddities.

This definitely makes me want to use verticality as one of those new challenges in these two areas - a feature that could buff ranged classes a bunch, being able to hit otherwise inaccessible positions, use height to their advantage, or even just using distance and the big, open space itself.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
Next up, I want to try to improve the initiative system's UI -
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/ad9b1cdafefb8b7897cfa160f08b7d72c83cc848.png[/img]
[i]Current initiative UI[/i]
-Afterwards, I plan on uploading the Netherguild demo onto Steam, and starting work on the new areas.

That's all for this update! Thank you for reading and see you next time (:

-David

notes.title: Netherguild's New Year Progress and Plans 2022
notes.content:
[i]This update was originally posted on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url].[/i]

[u]Hey everyone![/u] For the new year I wanted to share some of what I accomplished in 2021 and some of my plans for 2022 and beyond. Let's get started!

[h1]2021 Overview[/h1]

In the beginning of this year, I faced a few adversities - one of these was my laptop breaking for good. Netherguild's source code and assets were fine, but I had to use data-recovery for some of it's "planning files" containing ideas for future content.

A painful reminder to always back up all your files!

However, over the course of this year I also made significant progress developing Netherguild.

Some of the new additions include:
[list]
[*] Steam page!
[*] New Tutorial
[*] In-Game Feedback & Bug Reporting System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/3d023d99725990b9879d4fd4eaa83818bcc51955.gif[/img]
[*] [u]Opening Cutcene[/u]
[previewyoutube=iA6NzwWFcCE;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] [u]New Title Design[/u] (Designed by Alina Gottbrecht)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/597931b548fd58bda07c99b580ccf4c4358bec41.png[/img]
[*] [u]New Cover Art[/u] (Drawn by Victor Estivador)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/cf9e05193794750453522f718ee096700baff58b.png[/img]
[*] [u]Temporary Initial Trailer[/u] (preview in case you missed it!)
[previewyoutube=xWMuahIgERw;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] 500 wishlists so far (!!!!)
[/list]

Not to mention, the million other small things, like UI improvements and bug fixes, making Netherguild a better experience -
And your feedback, playtests, support, bug reports, and kind comments of everyone playing the demo so far on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Netherguild Discord[/url] and [url=https://superobot1.itch.io/netherguild]Itch.io[/url] - which were instrumental for making Netherguild better.

Oh yeah, prepare for an even better, more polished demo to appear on Netherguild's Steam page in early 2022 (;

[h1]Future Plans - 2022 and Beyond[/h1]

I also spent a lot of time this year planning all the remaining content for Netherguild!

Here's some early, initial previews of areas and enemies that are planned to be added for the Early Access release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/65274b257db3a900ce3e629231931501a1e1a0df.png[/img]
The bandit stronghold - all dangerous and filled with enemies and traps!
I want to play more with verticality in future designs of this area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/f62b9eb85f4d0c8589e415ad19f465bb39e8767f.png[/img]
The misty city - a long abandoned ancient city deep below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146018/5a9bcb88246da19aa3fecb71642f828d4c371b3e.png[/img]
A nasty, vicious little grub!

[b]Story[/b]
Expect the future story of Netherguild to get weird! 
You're going to see just how rough the separation between the two kingdoms ended up being, as well as all the broken pieces left behind and the fate of the Gaians...

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Random events will happen when the player returns from long expeditions in the future!
I plan for these to get progressively worse as the plague ramps up, which will make the Overworld just as hostile as the underworld.

[u]There's also around 4 big systems that Netherguild still lacks:[/u]
[b]Complete Factions System-[/b]
Including factions that hate you hunting you down during expeditions, and friendly factions
giving players access to some additional classes, items, equipment and perks!

[b]Building Upgrading[/b]
This one is not something I'm completely sure I'd like to add, but I've definitely considered it. It could be cool to make the overworld feel more alive that way, and give players more to do with their resources in the overworld.

[b]Enemy Encyclopedia[/b]
This one should be relatively easier to add, and should help players remember attacks that enemies used against them.
Will help prevent Netherguild from becoming a memorization game and help player strategize.

[b]Custom pre-made floors[/b]
Could be instrumental for creating a full, improved tutorial, as well as special areas underground.

[u]Expect to hear more about these systems in the future[/u] (:

[h1]Early Access Release[/h1]

I'm looking forward to releasing Netherguild in early access in 2022! There's still some areas I'd like to add to the game beforehand-
As well as things I need to figure out [i]before early access[/i] (like setting up a business entity and making the early access launch as awesome as it can be), 
and [i]after early access[/i] (how would regular updates look? Which areas of the game should I focus on first?).

While tasks like these may sound daunting at first, I'm honestly really looking forward to the next part of this big journey, and the Early Access release as a whole.
I hope you're just as excited as I am (:

[h1]Fin[/h1]

And that's all for now! Thanks for checking out the update.
If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know in the comments or in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/netherguild]Discord[/url], where I post regular weekly updates.
Other than that - hope you have a fantastic 2022!!!

-David Vinokurov
